I hate the naming so much. I cannot tell at all which is meant to be newer or superior.
Terrible benchmarks. They should probably compare the 395 GPU against the 9950 CPU or against a 7600/9060. If you're just going to use the CPU obviously the 395 is not what you want.
It would have been interesting to see the graphics performance and AI performance of the 395 compared to discrete gpus... how does it stack up against using real graphics cards.
Curiously, HP seems to embrace these Pro APUs more than any other brand, and yet they've never enabled a core feature of Pro APUs - ECC error reporting.
The performance is incredible... Now when will AMD put some real effort in to reducing power usage?

Own a framework desktop 128gb. GPU bandwidth limits the amount of tokens/sec that you get. I've mostly been running QWEN-3.6-35B-A3B at Q8 and QWEN-3.5-122B-A10B at Q4 with Q8 kv-cache on llama.cpp (vulkan version).
I'm running qwen3.6, gpt-oss and embeddinggemma with Ollama on Ryzen 7 8700G + 96 GB DDR5 with 12-14 tokens/sec... On Strix Halo it will run 4-6 times faster depending on memory bandwidth.
With 128 GB of unified memory, large models can fit into memory, but memory bandwidth quickly becomes the limiting factor. With long contexts, the KV cache can consume a lot of memory and bandwidth.
